description: Only the workflows are Renovate's business here.

Renovate's homebrew manager matches Formula/*.rb, but the formulae in this tap point at per-architecture release assets rather than the source archives that manager understands, and duckdb-otlp already bumps itself via update-duckdb-otlp.yml. Leaving it enabled would put the two in each other's way.

packageRules.description: One PR for all action bumps: this tap has a single workflow, so splitting them is pure noise.
